subject.title: feat(ui): approval UX overhaul — inline cards, fair queue, shortcuts, badges

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this full approval-surface overhaul after the two UI regressions are repaired and a real Control UI approval flow is demonstrated?
rationale: The PR deliberately expands the approval interaction model across modal, chat, keyboard, and sidebar surfaces; the protected `maintainer` label means acceptance of that UX scope requires explicit human direction beyond mechanical corrections.

options.title: Sponsor the full approval UX
options.body: Accept the multi-surface approval workflow once alias matching, bounded inline controls, and real-runtime proof are added.

options.title: Narrow the proposal
options.body: Keep the safest subset, such as fair modal queueing, and defer inline cards, shortcuts, or sidebar indicators to a separately scoped change.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Leave the current approval interaction model intact until a maintainer defines the desired approval UX contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the full approval UX
recommendation.body: Accept the multi-surface approval workflow once alias matching, bounded inline controls, and real-runtime proof are added.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current approval UX implementation and can provide the concrete behavior and scope context for a maintainer decision.
